    UfoLoadDiagnostics

    class UfoLoadDiagnostics

    Provenance, options, and entity counts from loading a UFO model.

    Diagnostics make it easy to verify which restriction was applied and how many particles, interactions, and auxiliary structures were normalized.

    Examples

    Replace path/to/MyUFO with the directory containing your UFO model (particles.py, vertices.py, and related files).

    from symbolica import S, E
from symbolica.community import hepkit as hep
loaded = hep.UfoLoader().load("path/to/MyUFO")
diagnostics = loaded.diagnostics
print(diagnostics.source, diagnostics.particle_count, diagnostics.vertex_rule_count)

    Attributes

    Name Description
    coupling_count Return the number of couplings loaded.
    form_factor_count Return the number of form factors loaded.
    function_count Return the number of model functions loaded.
    lorentz_structure_count Return the number of Lorentz structures loaded.
    model_parameter_count Return the number of model parameters loaded.
    order_count Return the number of coupling orders loaded from the UFO model.
    parameter_value_count Return the number of parameter values loaded into the parameter card.
    particle_count Return the number of particles loaded.
    propagator_count Return the number of propagators loaded.
    restriction_name Return the applied restriction-card name, if any.
    simplify_model Return whether model expressions were simplified while loading.
    source Return the UFO source directory.
    vertex_rule_count Return the number of vertex rules loaded.
    wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures Return whether normalized Lorentz indices were wrapped.
